subject: POC charter & model shortlist for Mosaic multilingual CX trial
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: POC charter & model shortlist for Mosaic multilingual CX trial

Hi Samira / Tom —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for walking through the call volumes and the language mix. Below is a short recap + proposed POC charter so we can align on success criteria, timeline, and who owns what. I captured a first-pass model shortlist that matches your latency & privacy constraints; happy to adjust.

Quick recap (from our discovery):
- Channels: voice->ASR transcripts + live chat (English, Spanish, Portuguese, French)
- Volume: peak 80 reqs/min (chat) with 95% under 3s p50 token latency target for short responses (~40 tokens)
- Data: transcripts stored for 30 days in your VPC; no PII leaves environment (private deployment requested for trial)
- Success for trial: 1) intent classification & suggested response quality >= 85% pass rate on your labeled set, 2) hallucination rate <= 5% on safety checks, 3) p95 latency < 800ms for 40-token outputs in standard traffic profile

Proposed POC scope (4-week core trial + 2-week wrap):
- Week 0 (prep): NDA + PO, access to 2000 anonymized transcripts, quick labeling for 10 intent categories
- Week 1–2 (staging): model pairing, infra spin-up (Redwood Private), run baseline evals on your eval set
- Week 3 (tuning): prompt templates, caching rules, quantization profile tests, rollout canary to 5% traffic
- Week 4 (validation): run dusk-to-dawn stress window, finalize metrics, review results & next steps
- Week 5–6 (optional extension): add longtail languages, expansion to voice-turn context windows

Model shortlist (first-pass) — we'll serve from your Private environment with limited external comms:
- Llama-2-13B-chat (8-bit quantized) — expected strong instruction following for customer messages
- Mistral-7B-Instruct (8-bit, low-latency variant) — good cost/latency tradeoff for high throughput
- Falcon-40B-Instruct (8-bit) — fallback for English-heavy threads where higher accuracy matters; evaluate at canary only
- OpenAssistant-oasst1 (fine-tune candidate) — for specialized retail prompts if we need domain safety control

Fallback strategy: route by language and latency budget — Mistral for fast Spanish/Portuguese responses, Llama-13B as default for mixed-English dialogues, Falcon-40B only for flagged escalations requiring stricter factuality. We will also enable KV-prefix caching for frequent catalogue queries to keep p95 under the target.

Owners (proposed):
- Mosaic: Samira (POC sponsor), Tom (launch ops) — provide eval set + acceptance criteria
- Redwood: Marissa (AE, commercial), Rishi (SE, infra & model experiments), Priyom (CS, success metrics & runbooks)

Attachments: I attached a one-sheet POC_success_criteria_v1.xlsx with the metric table and a short timeline.

Can you confirm: 1) NDA & PO cadence (who signs), 2) whether the 30-day retention policy is acceptable, and 3) if you want Falcon included in the initial canary? If yes to (3), we should budget an extra node for the canary.

Next step: if you confirm, we propose kicking off prep on Mon 12 Apr (spin-up window 2 business days).

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: POC charter & model shortlist for Mosaic multilingual CX trial

Diego — thanks for the thorough recap. This looks good and mirrors our expectations. A few clarifications: 

1) NDA/PO: legal should be able to sign the NDA this week; PO will take ~7–10 business days after NDA depending on finance. I’ll loop Nora (procurement) after the NDA.
2) Retention: 30 days is fine for the trial (we'll need to formalize for production).
3) Falcon in canary: yes, please include Falcon as a canary for English escalation paths — we want to compare hallucination tradeoffs.

Two additional asks: 
- Can you include a simple evaluation rubric for multilingual intent accuracy (we currently only have English resamples)?
- We need a lightweight cost estimate for running the 4-week trial (GPU-hours estimate + any seat/licenses).

If you can send those two items, we’ll try to accelerate PO but cannot commit before legal finishes the NDA.

Thanks —
Samira Khan
Head of CX Automation

Diego / team —

Quick infra + cost notes (ballpark):
- Recommended infra for Private POC: 3x A100-40GB equiv nodes (pool) + 1x V100-style node for Falcon canary to keep costs controllable. If you want 40B in-memory serving we should lift to 4x A100.
- Estimated compute burn (4-week core run, continuous baseline traffic + canary): ~220 GPU-hours (A100 equiv) + 40 GPU-hours for Falcon canary. Ballpark cost to Mosaic (usage only): $17k–$23k depending on sustained throughput and caching efficiency.

Model config notes:
- Llama-2-13B (8-bit) — expect p50 token latency ~80–120ms per token on A100; p95 for 40-token outputs ~420–600ms with batching and KV cache rules
- Mistral-7B — p95 ~300–450ms, very cost-effective for Spanish/Portuguese
- Falcon-40B — higher mem; use for canary only since it's more expensive (~2–3x cost per GPU-hour)

Evaluation harness: I can provide the model_shortlist_notes.pdf with initial eval scripts and CI thresholds. I'll also prepare a short Runbook for canary rollback and automated fallback rules.

Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Samira / Diego / team —

Attaching a lightweight multilingual evaluation rubric in the POC_success_criteria_v1.xlsx (also summarized below). We recommend starting with a stratified sample for labeling as Diego proposed.

Summary of rubric (excerpt):
- Intent accuracy: pass if macro-avg >= 0.85 (sampled per language)
- Slot-filling F1 (product/sku/entity): pass if overall F1 >= 0.80
- Hallucination check: random 200 QA checks across languages; pass if hallucination rate <= 5%
- Safety / PII leakage: 0 confirmed exfiltration in sample
- Latency targets: p50 < 300ms, p95 < 800ms for 40-token responses under expected load

Next actions I recommend we take if NDA is signed this week:
1) Mosaic to drop anonymized 2k transcripts into the shared Drive link (instructions in sheet)
2) Redwood to provision Private trial cluster (2 business days)
3) Labeling kickoff — we can provide a small labeling template and assist with 1 sprint of labeling to reach the stratified sample

I'll update the Drive with the eval harness and the runbook tonight.

Cheers —
Priyom Das
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
